purpose: Teach: 授与/保健所/延命/即答/一辺倒/疲弊/病名/早けれ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 優秀社員に表彰状の授与を行え
lines.en: I want you to present an award to our top performers.
lines.style: Measured, executive. Each word lands with weight. No rush—authority doesn't need hurry. Slight pause after the opening, like setting down a decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。保健所からの指導を共有しております
lines.en: Understood. I've compiled the guidance from the health department for the team.
lines.style: Respectful, efficient. Quick, clear delivery—showing competence through brevity. Warm undertone beneath the formality. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、サービスは延命対応も含めて検討しろ
lines.en: I want the company to evaluate our service options—including extended-term support.
lines.style: Commanding but not harsh. Deliberate pace. Each clause gets equal weight. Slight lean forward on 'extended-term'—he's thinking aloud while directing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。担当者は即答できる範囲を増やします
lines.en: Understood. We'll expand the scope of what our team can answer immediately.
lines.style: Assured, responsive. Light confidence—not defensive, just showing he's already thinking ahead. Even pace, slightly warm at the edges.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、一辺倒な戦略ではダメだ
lines.en: A one-sided approach won't work for this company.
lines.style: Firm conviction without aggression. The word 'won't' carries the weight—not a suggestion, a statement. Slight gravity in the tone, like he's seen this fail before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、疲弊しないよう休暇制度を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we have a proper leave policy so staff don't burn out.
lines.style: Earnest, genuine. Slightly softer than before—showing he connects with the concern beneath the directive. Steady pacing, no hurry.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、製品の病名表示を改善しろ
lines.en: I want the company to improve how we label disease information on our products.
lines.style: Direct, no-nonsense. Brisk delivery. The kind of instruction that expects no questions—just execution. Clean, precise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。早ければ来月に発表いたします
lines.en: Understood. We'll have an announcement ready as early as next month.
lines.style: Crisp, closing. Confident and quick—showing the task is already in motion. Final note of certainty, like closing a file.
